description: Set the length of zones on the edge. If the specified zone length causes the number of zones on the edge to exceed the limits (1-10000), the limit value is used for the edge.

7.0.reason: Not listed in the official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index.
7.0.note: 7.0 'extrude edge' exposes ratio / ratio-isolate and size / size-default / length / length-default instead of this 9.x keyword.
